name: sfx_comic_typing_01
text: Fast steady typing on a clicky mechanical keyboard late at night in a quiet room, a developer coding, continuous key clacks and an occasional space bar, close and intimate, no music.

name: sfx_comic_ring_01
text: A smartphone ringing on a wooden desk: two short electronic ring bursts with a buzzing vibration rattle, an urgent incoming call, then silence.

name: sfx_comic_shatter_01
text: A sharp sudden glass shatter: a computer monitor screen smashed by a heavy metal fist, an instant hard crack and burst of breaking glass with small shards tinkling down, short and punchy, no music, no voice.
